legend: Mark found an old automaton with two buttons in his attic, which he used to play with as a child. The toy is quite rusty, but it still performs its function. When the first button is pressed, a single 0$$$0$$$ appears on the screen, and when the other button is pressed, either due to age or malfunction, the automaton outputs k$$$k$$$ ones at once.

Mark became curious about how many different strings of lengths from ℓ$$$\ell$$$ to r$$$r$$$ can be obtained if the automaton outputs k$$$k$$$ ones when the second button is pressed. However, since the automaton is old and Mark's curiosity is great, you will have to answer q$$$q$$$ queries instead of the automaton.
Since the answer to any of Mark's queries can be very large, compute it modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.
input: In the first line, you are given 2$$$2$$$ integers n$$$n$$$ and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n,q≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the maximum length of the string and the number of queries.

In the next q$$$q$$$ lines, three integers ℓi, ri, ki$$$\ell_i, \ r_i, \ k_i$$$ are given (1≤ℓi≤ri≤n,1≤k≤n$$$1 \le \ell_i \le r_i \le n, 1 \le k \le n$$$) — the range of lengths and the number of ones that the automaton prints.
output: For each query, output the number of strings that the automaton can print modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: Mark 在阁楼里发现了一台带有两个按钮的老式自动机，他小时候常常用它玩耍。这个玩具已经相当破旧，但仍能正常工作。按下第一个按钮时，屏幕上会出现一个 0$$$0$$$；而按下另一个按钮时，或许是因为年久失修，或许是因为发生故障，自动机会一次输出 k$$$k$$$ 个 1。
如果按下第二个按钮时自动机会输出 k$$$k$$$ 个 1，Mark 对能够得到的长度从 ℓ$$$\ell$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 的不同字符串数量产生了好奇。然而，由于自动机已经老旧，而 Mark 的好奇心很强，你需要代替自动机回答 q$$$q$$$ 个查询。
由于 Mark 的任意查询的答案都可能非常大，请将其对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模。

input.ai: 第一行给出 2$$$2$$$ 个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$(1≤n,q≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n, q \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——字符串的最大长度和查询次数。
接下来 q$$$q$$$ 行中，每行给出三个整数 ℓi、ri、ki$$$\ell_i, \ r_i, \ k_i$$$(1≤ℓi≤ri≤n，1≤k≤n$$$1 \le \ell_i \le r_i \le n, 1 \le k \le n$$$)——长度范围以及自动机输出的 1 的个数。

output.ai: 对于每个查询，输出自动机能够输出的字符串数量对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
